# Maintenance

The question is no longer only how to preserve an object. It is how a group keeps the ability to continue when a particular person leaves. An instruction that only its author may revise still depends on that author. A rota can share labour while leaving every difficult decision with one tired volunteer.

Name who can change a procedure, refuse a request and retire an obligation. Give temporary offers an end date. A successful handover transfers authority as well as a checklist. [[Volunteer handbook]] and the completed [[Exhibition plan]] offer different cases. Keep failures and ordinary intervals when no rescue was needed, without treating the absence of a crisis as proof that every possible failure has been prevented. Reliable arrangements should make rest and departure possible.
